analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 탈출 + MACD 개선 지속
analysis.reason: RSI가 5일 전 38.3에서 56.4로 과매도 구간을 탈출했고, MACD 히스토그램도 -1.0374에서 0.4916으로 개선되며 상승 추세가 강화되고 있다. 5일 저가($166.46) 대비 현재가($184.50)가 10% 이상 상승하며 Higher Low 패턴을 형성하고 있다.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold from 38.3 to 56.4 over 5 days, and MACD histogram improved from -1.0374 to 0.4916, strengthening the uptrend. The price has risen over 10% from the 5-day low ($166.46) to $184.50, forming a Higher Low pattern.

analysis.patternNoteEn: RSI's exit from oversold and MACD histogram improvement are positive, forming a Higher Low pattern with the current price rising from the 5-day low. Volume is subdued, but the uptrend is maintained.
